description_en: Enables log delivery for onboarded cloud services
description_zh: 开通已经接入产品日志的投递
kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem open-delivery --product-code cfw --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2022-06-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: OpenDelivery

parameters.name: product_code

parameters.help_en: The log code of the cloud service, such as the process log in Security Center. This parameter is optional. If you do not specify this parameter, the operation applies to all logs of the cloud service
parameters.help_zh: 云产品下的日志code，比如云安全中心的进程日志，非必填，缺失时表示云产品下的所有日志的操作
parameters.name: log_code

parameters.help_en:
The view type. Valid values:

0: the view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.
1: the view of all accounts in the enterprise
parameters.help_zh:
视图类型。

0：当前阿里云账号视图。
1：企业下所有账号的视图
parameters.name: role_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the member whose perspective the administrator switches to
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

parameters.help_en:
The region where the data management center of Threat Analysis is located. You must select the region of the management center based on the region where your assets are located. Valid values:
cn-hangzhou: Select this value if your assets are located in the Chinese mainland or Hong Kong (China).
ap-southeast-1: Select this value if your assets are located outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港，选择该项。
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域，选择该项
parameters.name: region_id

Data.description_en:
Indicates whether log delivery is enabled. Valid values:
true: Log delivery is enabled.
false: Log delivery failed to be enabled
Data.description_zh:
开通日志投递是否成功，取值：
true：开通成功
false：开通失败
